title: Vest of Soul Rejuvenation

sources.title: Defier's Rejuvenation
markers: | description = Whenever the wearer succeeds on a {{SavingThrow}} against a [[Spells|Spell]], they regain {{DamageText|1d4|Healing}}.

summary: Clothing with +2 AC, healing on successful spell saves and an unarmed counter.

fields.Defence: Clothing, base AC 10 + Dexterity modifier and a +2 AC bonus.
fields.Defier’s Rejuvenation: Regain 1d4 HP when you succeed on a save against a spell.
fields.Greater Kushigo Counter: Spend a Reaction after an attacker misses to make an Unarmed Strike against it. A counter on your own turn can trigger Extra Attack. The source reports that countering with a normal Extra Attack already active can lose both follow-ups. Honour Mode applies its additional-action restrictions.
fields.Acquisition: Rolan or Lorroakan’s Projection in Sorcerous Sundries, depending on who is alive. If Rolan lives and Lorroakan is dead, trade via Rolan’s dialogue at Ramazith’s Tower.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and exact item and dependency citations.
